answers.answer: Invitation capacity counts all outgoing history, including people outside the CRM, before selecting up to 25 qualified prospects. Exact recipients are counted against cited current employers with a three-person lifetime company cap; qualification citations bind to the same canonical profile with ASCII-safe hashing; contaminated legacy CRM rows reconcile only under strict uniqueness conditions while ambiguous evidence stays unresolved.
The matrix pins all-history capacity counting and strict legacy reconciliation: ambiguous names, collisions and conflicting dates stay unresolved.
